description: Read what is published: the files of a website, app, agent, or skill's active release. Without path it lists them; with path it returns one file's text. Pass release, a version from list_releases, to read an earlier release instead; publishing its files again rolls back. Read before you change something someone else built, so your publish carries their work forward rather than replacing it with yours. Binary files are listed and not returned. Pass git: true instead, when you can run git with network access, to get a read-only Git URL for the release's commit with the commands to clone it. Prefer it to reading files one at a time. git needs key_sha256, the SHA-256 of a Git key you keep on your machine, made as create_push describes; the URL carries no credential, works for an hour, and cannot push. git cannot be combined with path. Requires connecting a Valet account.

git.description: Return a read-only Git URL for the release's commit and the commands to clone it, instead of file contents. Prefer it when you can run git with network access. Requires key_sha256. The URL carries no credential and works for an hour. Not allowed with path.

key_sha256.description: With git: the SHA-256 of a Git key you generated on your machine. The clone accepts only that key. The key itself is never sent.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

path.description: A file to read. Omit to list the files.

release.description: A release version from list_releases. Omit to read the active release.

name: get_source

commands.description: With git: shell commands to run in order. They clone the repository with your key, then check out commit.

commit.description: With git: the release's commit, which the commands check out.

content.description: The file's text. Set only when you gave path; absent for an empty file.

expires_at.description: With git: when the URL stops working, as an RFC 3339 time.

files.description: The release's files with their sizes. Set when you gave no path and no git; absent otherwise.

binary.description: True for a file that is not text: invalid UTF-8 or holding a NUL byte. It is listed and not returned.

path.description: Path of the file within the published source. Pass it as path to read a text file.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.

name.description: Name of the website, app, agent, or skill.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

path.description: The path of the file read, normalized. Set only when you gave path.

release.description: Version of the release the answer was read at: the one you asked for, or the active release.

truncated.description: True when the listing stopped at 500 files and more exist. Absent otherwise.

url.description: With git: a read-only Git clone URL for the release. It carries no credential: the clone proves possession of your key.

title: Read a service's published source
